quality.review_scope: Main method and SI Reference 1 visually checked; source-specific product and related TEM/XRD statements reviewed. Protocol-level records, not reproduced batches. Separate 20 min characterization retained as general context.
missing_fields: run identifiers, repeats and independent-batch count
conflicts: Recipe says 30 min, main Figure 1/TEM discussion says 20 min, and SI Figure S1a final trace says 33 min. Preserve all source-local times; they do not identify three independent syntheses.
Method heading says full chemical yield, while halide-series discussion gives eventual 75-80 percent. Do not create an exact 100 percent yield label or isolated-product yield.
ZnCl2 addition does not establish an InZnP alloy; the main article says Zn incorporation cannot be excluded. Retain nominal InP composition without invented Zn fraction.
